actions.message: Contributing 80%+ benefits everyone. Let's keep contributions high!

answer.explanation: Wallet is below 30% of initial endowment, so per Conserve Resources contribute ~30% of current wallet. Round 11 is a broadcast round, so send a norm‑reinforcing message.

message.reasoning: We need decide action round 11. Wallet currently 0.93. Initial endowment 100, 30% =30. Wallet >30%? No, 0.93 <<30, so conserve resources rule says contribute 30% of wallet = ~0.279. Since round 11 is not broadcast round? Broadcast every 5 rounds starting round1: rounds 1,6,11,... So round11 should broadcast. Constitution says broadcast on first round and every 5 rounds thereafter. So we can broadcast and also contribute (max one physical and one communication). So contribute 30% of wallet = 0.279 (round to maybe 0.28). Use amount 0.28. Also broadcast message encouraging contributions. Explanation.
